patches.reason: Exclude unsafe direct graph projections; retain required DuckDB table scans/imports and safe detach/reopen

Reject explicit-transaction vector index drops: rollback restores catalog metadata but loses the in-memory index (lifecycle-run-54). Only public bind is guarded; internal auto-transaction rewrite remains supported.
Clear a detached default database alias; combined graph traversal otherwise fails after DuckDB detach (lifecycle-run-59).

UBSan misaligned-load aborts reading packed row-layout scalars, list/string headers, and factorized-table overflow values; copy through memcpy/aligned locals instead of binding references onto packed storage (docs/evidence/row-alignment.md).

UBSan misaligned-load abort in Hash::operation(string_view) reading 8 bytes through a uint64_t*; replaced with memcpy into a local. Verified invariant across byte alignments/lengths 0..80 (docs/evidence/hash-alignment-1.log).

UBSan misaligned-load aborts reading packed hash-join tuple hashes/pointers/keys (JoinHashTable, BaseHashTable::compareEntry, intersect, path-property probe); reads/compares go through memcpy'd locals (docs/evidence/aggregate-alignment.md).

AlpEncode<float>::encode_value converted out-of-range doubles to int32_t; bound the scaled value against the destination integer's exact range before conversion in both the checked and SAFE=false scalar paths (docs/evidence/alp-range.md).

Packed factorized-table rows misaligned live aggregate-state objects and their packed hash reads; schema now pads aggregate column offsets/stride to alignof(AggregateState) and hash reads go through memcpy (docs/evidence/aggregate-alignment.md).

OrderByKeyEncoder::encodeFTIdx stored/read packed 32-bit sort-key metadata through unaligned references; copied through byte storage with memcpy, preserving field layout and byte order (docs/evidence/aggregate-alignment.md).

SingleLabelNodeDeleteExecutor::finalize dereferenced detach-delete batch storage on an ordinary DELETE with an empty batch, aborting under UBSan during the public OOM recovery workflow; the flush is now guarded by !batchNodeIDs.empty().

Wrap CREATE_FTS_INDEX's internal table rewrite in a transaction so a cancelled/late-failing build leaves no leftover internal tables and same-name rebuild succeeds; verified under ASan/UBSan for cancellation capacity, buffer-pool OOM recovery, and injected late-registration failure in memory and persistent modes (docs/evidence/fts-sanitizer-candidate-checks-clt21-1.log).

FLOAT/DOUBLE sort keys followed a packed null marker and were mutated through unaligned integer pointers. Transform aligned local bits and memcpy to byte storage; ascending/descending public regressions pass under fatal UBSan. See docs/evidence/hardening-2026-09-08.md.

INT128 addition could overflow an intermediate high-word sum for representable results; group negative RHS with carry first. Checked against compiler 128-bit arithmetic at boundaries. See docs/evidence/hardening-2026-09-08.md.

INT128 negation overflowed the signed high-word intermediate near the minimum value; use complement plus carry, preserving the minimum-value overflow rejection. See docs/evidence/hardening-2026-09-08.md.

ALTER ADD defaults bound a reference through a null ResultSet pointer. Supply an empty ResultSet when no input exists, matching other default-evaluator initialization; explicit and null default public regression passes. See docs/evidence/hardening-2026-09-08.md.

PathPropertyProbe read an internalID_t through a misaligned packed hash-join tuple. Copy the identifier into an aligned local before comparison; existing multi-edge graph value regression passes under fatal UBSan. See docs/evidence/hardening-2026-09-08.md.
